subject: BridgeWorks GRC integration kickoff & evidence exchange
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@bridgeworks.co>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 7 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BridgeWorks x Redwood — GRC integration kickoff

Hi Lauren,

Great to meet you last week — following up with a short note to kick off the integration and evidence-exchange workflow we discussed. BridgeWorks would like to connect our GRC evidence broker to Redwood so that customers can pull SOC2 artifacts and pen-test results directly into their BridgeWorks workspaces.

High-level asks from our side:
- 1) A secure endpoint or transfer workflow (S3 role, pre-signed URLs, or secure SFTP) for nightly evidence syncs.
- 2) A contact for SOC2 mapping and sample artifact names/paths.
- 3) Pen-test scoping and a PO/contract contact if we engage RedTeam Labs for an external check.

We propose a short technical kickoff this Wednesday (30 minutes) to agree on format and handoff. Do you prefer Wed 11–11:30 PT or Thu 2–2:30 PT?

I've looped in RedTeam (ops@redteamlabs.com) to align on scope for a co-delivered penetration test option — they can provide scoping templates if you want.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Integrations, BridgeWorks
alex@bridgeworks.co

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@bridgeworks.co>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 7 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BridgeWorks x Redwood — GRC integration kickoff

Alex — thanks for the clear summary. Happy to get this moving. Wed 11 PT works for me.

A few clarifying points so we come prepared:
- Evidence transport: we prefer short-lived pre-signed S3 URLs into a dedicated bucket per partner for one-way uploads from partners; we can also support SFTP if necessary. Can you confirm what BridgeWorks can push?
- Artifact naming: please send a sample naming convention (we use artifact_type/customer_id/yyyy-mm-dd_v1) so we can map fields into our evidence indexer.
- Data retention & redaction: we will need to agree on retention windows and whether artifacts contain PII that must be redacted before transfer.
- Pen test: if RedTeam is engaged, who owns contracting and payment? We typically route vendor PO through Procurement (cc Marissa) and need a statement of work + insurance cert.

Sergio — can you take the integration acceptance criteria and add an ops checklist (S3 path, IAM role, object schema) ahead of the call? Marissa — can you confirm procurement steps and preferred vendor intake form to share on Wed?

I'll schedule the 11:00 PT slot and include a short agenda.

Best,
Lauren
VP Partnerships, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 7 Feb 2027 12:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BridgeWorks x Redwood — GRC integration kickoff

Thanks Lauren — adding my operational notes so we have a concrete checklist for Wed's call.

Draft ops checklist (high level):
- S3 path: s3://redwood-partner-uploads/bridgeworks/{customer_id}/
- Upload method: pre-signed PUT URL (preferred) OR SFTP endpoint
- IAM: BridgeWorks service account will assume a restricted role with PutObject + ListBucket limited to the prefix; tokens rotate every 12 hours
- Schema: CSV/JSON manifest + artifacts zipped (artifact_type, customer_id, timestamp, sha256)
- Retention: default 90 days; retention override per-customer (must be in writing)
- Redaction: BridgeWorks to mark artifacts that contain PII in the manifest; Redwood will not accept PII in raw form — requirement: PII redacted or encrypted, and we need a redaction checklist
- Pen-test handoff: RedTeam to submit scoping doc + insurance cert. Procurement to issue PO once SOW agreed.

I'll prep a minimal acceptance test we can run during the PoC: partner uploads a sample artifact set for a test customer, Redwood ingests and surfaces in evidence index, mapping verified. Estimate: 2-week PoC once S3 creds and manifest format agreed.

Sergio
Head of Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
